purpose: Audit causal prefix-only three-way inference, future-suffix noninterference, deterministic replay, and append-only hash-chain integrity under simultaneous trend/noise transitions.

frozen_protocol.generator: SG052 deterministic synthetic generator, same 27 combinations of previous direction, current direction and AR1 regime. Onset fixed per k at 100,120,140 but unknown to controller.
frozen_protocol.inference: SG052 frozen trailing min(100,n) HAC3 median-bin estimator, z=4.327111573414373; only observed prefix [0:n] passed. Direction positive,negative,zero,unresolved per frozen SG052 classification.
frozen_protocol.suffix_edits: At each n<240, hold [0:n] unchanged; replace future [n:240] with upward ramp, downward ramp, or deterministic permutation. Exact prior decision must remain identical for every modification. At n=240 future suffix is empty, so no vacuous edits counted.
frozen_protocol.replay: JSON round-trip of same numeric prefix at each checkpoint; classification must match exactly.
frozen_protocol.append_only: Each checkpoint appends event {n,prefix_digest,decision,parent_hash}, with SHA256 of sorted-key compact JSON canonical payload. Subsequent events must link parent hash, and independent chain replay must verify.
frozen_protocol.negative_control: Deliberately invalid policy classifies full 240-point data at early checkpoints, then tests same suffix changes; measured sensitivity demonstrates ability of audit to detect future-lookahead. Control deliberately violates diodic causal rule.
frozen_protocol.scoring: At every checkpoint compare decision to final programmed post-change direction, separately report correct/missed direction/false direction/unresolved. This is diagnostic only, not an online commitment policy.
frozen_protocol.acceptance: Zero tested prefix interference, replay or chain violations on holdout; negative control detects some leakage (nonzero changed decisions), no claim this exhaustively proves absence of all possible leakage.

pilot.disclosure: Pilot was executed and inspected before freeze, including a prefreeze correction to omit vacuous suffix edits at n=240. Freeze preserves unchanged estimator and thresholds.

report: all failed cases and immutable event roots

limitations: Prefix noninterference and hash-chain verification are software tests, not formal proofs against arbitrary code paths.
Synthetic programmed truth and transition generator are unchanged from SG052; no field transfer.
A correct prefix-only output may still be wrong about the post-change direction, especially before transition.
Hash chains provide tamper-evidence only if reference roots are retained in trusted storage; these tests do not establish distributed consensus.
